title: Do You Believe in “Physiognomy”?
synopsis: Traditional Chinese face reading, or physiognomy, believes that certain facial features are auspicious.

fullText.simplified:
你相信“面相”吗？

    中国古代人都比较迷信。盖房子、买房子注重风水，结婚要看八字（简单点说就是人的出生时间），还有一个比较关键的是看人的“面相”，也就是长相。那时的人们认为一个人的五官、气色决定一个人的吉凶。
    那什么样的长相是“吉相”呢？有这么句俗语是：富看鼻，贵看眼。
    鼻子是五官中最明显的地方，所以“富看鼻”的意思就是鼻子高挺，鼻头饱满圆润的人一般来说财运和事业都会十分顺利，即使以后遇到了困难，也会有人帮助解决。
    都说“眼睛是心灵的窗户”，通过眼睛能够看到一个人的内心。“贵看眼”说的就是眼睛长而且深，瞳仁大而且黑，最重要的是眼神清澈。拥有这种眼睛的人是善良和正直的，也就是人们嘴里常说的好人。
    当然啦，这种说法来自中国古人的“天命论”，他们认为一个人的富贵或者贫穷是天定的。随着社会的发展和人们认知水平的提高，人们逐渐明白命运是自己掌握的，只要努力提升自己，就会有收获。
fullText.traditional:
你相信“面相”嗎？

    中國古代人都比較迷信。蓋房子、買房子注重風水，結婚要看八字（簡單點說就是人的出生時間），還有一個比較關鍵的是看人的“面相”，也就是長相。那時的人們認為一個人的五官、氣色決定一個人的吉凶。
    那什麼樣的長相是“吉相”呢？有這麼句俗語是：富看鼻，貴看眼。
    鼻子是五官中最明顯的地方，所以“富看鼻”的意思就是鼻子高挺，鼻頭飽滿圓潤的人一般來說財運和事業都會十分順利，即使以後遇到了困難，也會有人幫助解決。
    都說“眼睛是心靈的窗戶”，通過眼睛能夠看到一個人的內心。“貴看眼”說的就是眼睛長而且深，瞳仁大而且黑，最重要的是眼神清澈。擁有這種眼睛的人是善良和正直的，也就是人們嘴裡常說的好人。
    當然啦，這種說法來自中國古人的“天命論”，他們認為一個人的富貴或者貧窮是天定的。隨著社會的發展和人們認知水平的提高，人們逐漸明白命運是自己掌握的，只要努力提昇自己，就會有收穫。

sentences.simplified: 那时的人们认为一个人的五官、气色决定一个人的吉凶。
sentences.traditional: 那時的人們認為一個人的五官、氣色決定一個人的吉凶。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí de rén men rèn wéi yí ge rén de wǔ guān qì sè jué dìng yí ge rén de jí xiōng
sentences.english: It was also important to read a person’s “physiognomy”, that is, their appearance.
At that time, people believed that a person’s five sense organs and complexion determined fate.

sentences.english: So what kind of appearance was “auspicious“?
There is a proverb that goes: see wealth by the nose and see nobility by the eyes.

sentences.simplified: 即使以后遇到了困难，也会有人帮助解决。
sentences.traditional: 即使以後遇到了困難，也會有人幫助解決。

sentences.english: So “see wealth by the nose” means people with high, full, and rounded noses generally have good luck making money and a successful career.
Even if they encounter difficulties, there will be someone to help them.

sentences.simplified: 最重要的是眼神清澈。
sentences.traditional: 最重要的是眼神清澈。
sentences.pinyin: zuì zhòng yào de shì yǎn shén qīng chè

sentences.english: .. and most importantly, the eyes have a clear expression.
People with such eyes are kind and upright. They are often described as good people.

sentences.traditional: 隨著社會的發展和人們認知水平的提高，人們逐漸明白命運是自己掌握的，

sentence_translations: Ancient Chinese people were quite superstitious. They paid attention to feng shui when building or buying a house.
They looked at the “eight characters” (simply put, the time of birth) before marriage.
It was also important to read a person’s “physiognomy”, that is, their appearance.
At that time, people believed that a person’s five sense organs and complexion determined fate.
So what kind of appearance was “auspicious“?
There is a proverb that goes: see wealth by the nose and see nobility by the eyes.
The nose is the most distinct of the five sense organs.
So “see wealth by the nose” means people with high, full, and rounded noses generally have good luck making money and a successful career.
Even if they encounter difficulties, there will be someone to help them.
It is said that “the eyes are the windows to the soul”. You can see a person’s heart through the eyes.
“See nobility by the eyes” means that the eyes are long and deep, the pupils are large and dark, ..
.. and most importantly, the eyes have a clear expression.
People with such eyes are kind and upright. They are often described as good people.
Of course, this kind of theory comes from the “concept of destiny” in ancient China.
They believed that a person’s wealth or poverty was predestined.
With the development of society and people’s increased awareness, people gradually understood that their destiny is in their own hands.
As long as you work hard to improve yourself, you will be rewarded.
